condition_cn: 条件：90分钟常规时间打平；输入包括完整90分钟预测、平局比分分布、淘汰赛证据、常规时间Tail与MAS结论。

points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段时间短且淘汰赛风险偏好下降，仍平是基础高概率分支。
points.rationale_en: Extra time is short and knockout risk appetite drops, so remaining level is the baseline high-probability branch.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
points.rationale_cn: Colombia凭借体能、替补或压迫优势在加时净胜一球。
points.rationale_en: Colombia wins extra time by one goal through fitness, bench depth, or pressing advantage.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
points.rationale_cn: Ghana凭借体能、替补或反击效率在加时净胜一球。
points.rationale_en: Ghana wins extra time by one goal through fitness, bench depth or counterattack efficiency.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: Colombia在对手体能或心理崩盘后拉开比分。
points.rationale_en: Colombia pulls away after the opponent breaks down physically or mentally.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段比赛打开，双方各有一次有效转化。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score
points.rationale_en: The game opens up in extra time, with each side converting one clear chance.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段体能崩溃或开放对攻形成的低频高偏离路径。
points.rationale_en: A low-frequency tail path where fatigue or open extra-time play creates a wider scoring swing.

tail_focus.rationale_en: Colombia wins extra time by one goal through fitness, bench depth, or pressing advantage.

tail_focus.rationale_en: Colombia pulls away after the opponent breaks down physically or mentally.

key_factors.impact_cn: 若90分钟后仍平，哥伦比亚仍可能通过边路轮转、定位球、二点球和边路疲劳错位制造加时优势。
key_factors.impact_en: If it remains level after 90 minutes, Colombia can still create an extra-time edge through wide rotations, set pieces, second balls and tired wide mismatches.
key_factors.text_cn: 若90分钟后仍平，哥伦比亚仍可能通过边路轮转、定位球、二点球和边路疲劳错位制造加时优势。
key_factors.text_en: If it remains level after 90 minutes, Colombia can still create an extra-time edge through wide rotations, set pieces, second balls and tired wide mismatches.

key_factors.impact_cn: 加纳进入加时意味着低比分守平路径奏效，但Kudus缺阵削弱从推进到高质量射门的上限，Semenyo、Ayew和Sulemana的体能会很关键。
key_factors.impact_en: Ghana reaching extra time means the low-scoring containment path has worked, but Kudus’ absence lowers the ceiling from progression to high-quality shots. Semenyo, Ayew and Sulemana’s remaining legs are key.

key_factors.impact_cn: 加纳低位防守具备拖住比赛的韧性；若105分钟仍平，加纳更可能继续压低风险并接受点球路径。
key_factors.impact_en: Ghana’s low block has the resilience to keep the match close. If it remains level at 105 minutes, Ghana are more likely to keep risk low and accept the penalty route.

key_factors.impact_cn: 哥伦比亚可以制造压力，但高射门量并不必然转化为进球；若加时继续久攻不下，心理压力会向热门方累积。
key_factors.impact_en: Colombia can generate pressure, but high shot volume does not automatically become goals. If extra-time pressure does not convert, psychological pressure can build on the favorite.
